text:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT: Eviction storm detected in prefix cache (us-west-2). Hit-rate collapsed from ~95% to ~12% across warm/seq workloads. Paging @anna_oncall and @ben_sre. Severity: P1.

anna_oncall: I'm awake, looking. Any customer-facing errors yet?

ben_sre: seeing increased 502/503s from runtime at 18:23 UTC correlating with token latency spikes. UI graphs -> https://grafana.redwood.local/d/prefix-cache?orgId=1&from=now-30m

carla_runtime: confirming. KV eviction rate metric jumped ~x40 at 18:21. Tagging logs now.

dan_ml: could be rewarm path failure — models falling back to cold start frequently. We're seeing KV miss counts spike for repeated prefixes.

elaine_prod: Customer impact: a subset of high-throughput customers report elevated latencies and some downstream requeues; I have message draft ready if needed.

infra-bot: Autoscale triggered burst group 3 -> provisioning delayed due to quota check latencies. Instance spinup lag ~30s.

ben_sre: quick hypothesis list (initial): 1) recent eviction-config rollout reduced cache-size-per-shard 2) prefix invalidation job ran unexpectedly 3) KV TTL calc bug for certain keys 4) rewarm pipeline throttling.

anna_oncall: can someone post the last config change? check config history for /configs/prefix-cache in 30m window.

carla_runtime: pulling config now. Latest config change at 18:18 UTC by infra-deploy-ci: `prefix_cache.max_shard_memory_mb: 1024 -> 512` and `eviction_policy: aggressive`.

ben_sre: that matches the timeline. Eviction policy flip at 18:18, hit-rate drop at 18:21. Strong correlation.

dan_ml: logs show rewarm queue backlog growth starting 18:20. Rewarm worker processes hit CPU saturation around 18:22.

anna_oncall: mitigation plan (live): 1) roll back prefix_cache.max_shard_memory_mb to 1024 2) set eviction_policy to conservative 3) temporarily lift rate-limiter for rewarm workers 4) if still bad, route critical customers to fallback pool. Who can execute rollback?

carla_runtime: I can push a rollback to canary in 2m and then to full by hand after verification. Running command:

```bash
# canary rollback
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN" \
  https://config.redwood.internal/api/v1/configs/prefix-cache/rollback \
  -d '{"target":"canary","to_revision":"rev-9241"}'
```

carla_runtime: canary rollback queued, will report status.

ben_sre: capturing timeline notes: 18:16 - scheduled config rollout starts, 18:18 - config change applied cluster-wide, 18:20 - eviction rate spike begins, 18:21 - client error increase, 18:22 - rewarm backlog, 18:23 - pager fired.

frank_customer: FYI our side saw degraded throughput around 18:22, opened a ticket. Want updates to include ETA for mitigation.

elaine_prod: drafting customer note. ETA: 20-30m for rollback + verification. Will send upon confirmation of rollback started.

carla_runtime: canary rollback completed at 18:27. Monitoring canary metrics now.

ben_sre: canary hit-rate: improved from 12% -> 78% within one minute on canary shard. Latency normalized on canary.

anna_oncall: good sign. Proceed to full rollback once infra-deploy CI approvals complete.

carla_runtime: pushing full rollback now.

infra-bot: Config change applied to 14/16 shards at 18:33; remaining shards pending due to rolling deploy.

ben_sre: global hit-rate trending up. cluster-level prefix hit-rate now 67% at 18:35 and climbing.

dan_ml: rewarm worker backlog drained after eviction-policy rollback and temporary rate lift. No more cold starts reported for previously affected prefixes as of 18:37.

anna_oncall: switching to post-mitigations checklist: 1) keep monitoring for 1h for regressions 2) capture full timeline and logs 3) collect heap/eviction metrics pre/post 4) prepare RCA thread for postmortem.

carla_runtime: exporting logs for window 18:10-18:40. Key query: `service:prefix-cache evict_event OR miss_count | json` Result saved to GCS `gs://redwood-incident-exports/eviction-storm/1805239012/`.

ben_sre: saved snapshot of prom metrics (evictions_total, hit_rate, rewarm_queue_length) and grafana panels.

frank_customer: thanks for the quick rollback. Can you confirm whether key-value data was lost or just evicted?

carla_runtime: no data deletion — eviction only. Values will be re-fetched/rewarm; TTLs preserved.

elaine_prod: customer update going out: noted rollback completed and customers on fallback are being re-provisioned. ETA for full verification 30m.

anna_oncall: handing off to ben_sre for extended monitoring and RCA. My shift ends in 25m. Ben, you're on until 19:30 UTC.

ben_sre: taking handoff. Will keep this thread as live RCA coordinator. Next steps: 1) attach config diff 2) collect rewarm traces 3) estimate customer impact (requests affected) 4) propose safe guard (feature flag gate for eviction params).

dan_ml: quick data point: top 5 prefixes accounted for 62% of cache pressure. Those prefixes had large embedding sequences and were sensitive to shard mem limit.

carla_runtime: adding to RCA notes: the deploy pipeline did not enforce a canary-only change for memory reductions; rollout was cluster-wide because of a mis-tag. Will open a follow-up on the deploy tool.

ben_sre: adding hypothesis tags in-thread: [config-rollback-success], [eviction-param-too-low], [deploy-rollout-bug], [rewarm-throttle]. We'll track evidence per hypothesis.

anna_oncall: thanks team. If anything pops, ping me but I’m off in 25min. Good job. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2 at 18:45 UTC after rollback and metrics stabilized. Create postmortem in #postmortems and link artifacts: logs, config diffs, grafana snapshots.

ben_sre: creating a stub postmortem now and will link exported artifacts: `gs://redwood-incident-exports/eviction-storm/1805239012/` and PR with proposed guard rails.

elaine_prod: will prepare customer-facing summary and coordinate any follow-ups with sales/support.

frank_customer: appreciate the fast response. We'll wait for the full postmortem.

carla_runtime: follow-ups I already filed: 1) patch to prevent memory-downscale without canary 2) add preflight check to block eviction policy flips if heavy prefixes detected 3) improve rewarm autoscaling trigger.

ben_sre: end-of-thread status: rollback completed, hit-rate recovered, no KV data loss, postmortem stub created, follow-up action items assigned. Closing active paging loop.

incident-bot: Incident declared resolved at 18:58 UTC. Please add any missing logs or notes to the postmortem ticket.
